title: Carrier–phonon coupling driven enhanced thermoelectric performance of Sn-substituted bismuth sulphide for intermediate-temperature applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00517E, Paper
E. Karvannan, V. Vijay, T. S. Nivin, M. Navaneethan, J. Archana, A. Karthigeyan
Sn substitution in Bi2S3 gives a significantly optimized power factor of 192 μW m−1 K−2 with a low lattice thermal conductivity of 0.340 W m−1 K−1, resulting in an enhanced zT of 0.42 at 623 K for the Bi1.90Sn0.10S3 sample.
